en.title: Markus Saueregger, stARTup gallery, Kötschach-Mauthen
en.meta_description: Markus Saueregger runs the stARTup gallery, Kötschach 5, Kötschach-Mauthen, opened in May 2023, and curates its exhibitions of artists from the Gail valley.
